reviewer_statement: Developer-side source-semantic parity review against frozen Python 1.2. The native implementation now handles zero-component source truth assessment. A direct typed Python 1.2 oracle is committed for four distinct scientific truth records and both related evaluator contracts; full nine-column metric row payloads and provenance are compared for nonempty records. No exact-head CI success or independent certification has yet been observed.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python FunctionalRecoveryAssessment and FunctionalRecoveryValue dataclasses map to ordered, validated native R scientific lists and registered metric metadata; source numerical estimands, zero-based component identity, 0-denominator/zero-eigen semantics and provenance are preserved. Native R code does not call Python.

case_evidence.description: Frozen eyetrajectoriespy==1.2.0 src/eyetrajectoriespy/recovery.py native scientific record export and typed source objects

Four frozen Python source-shaped truth records: baseline, three-curve nonuniform time grid/multicomponent hierarchy, zero declared eigenvalues, and zero-retained-component truth; plus perturbed registration and malformed native input tests.

Eight paired source evaluator outputs from four scientific cases: full typed Python results and native R semantic metric records, all available nine-column metric rows and registered metadata, metrics order and 0-based component labels, provenance; empty result compared at native value level.

Native R rejects malformed score source geometry, nonfinite truth values, mismatched fitted and truth grids, mismatched warp dimensions, and nonmonotone generating warps. Python TypeError/ValueError condition identity is language specific.

Python FunctionalRecoveryAssessment immutable dataclass values tuple and provenance Mapping map to native R validated `etr_functional_recovery_assessment` list and provenance. Nonempty output maps to source-ordered nine-column metric data.frame.

Population ddof=0 variance recovery for curve, participant, and trial score sources; zero eigenvalue skips a relative error; zero-component truth returns empty metric values and retains published provenance.

independent_review_status: Developer-reviewed full source semantics, exact-head three-OS R and frozen Python 1.2 comparison CI pending; zero independent certification.
language_specific_limits: Python dataclass and tuple runtime identity, arbitrary invalid source class inputs and Python exception classes differ from native R scientific result records
Python NumPy floating-point BLAS/platform exact bit identity is not promised; numerical comparisons use 1e-12 tolerance

Empty Python assessment has no values and does not pass the separate native assessment_frame converter's currently positive-value requirement; only the evaluator output is reviewed in that source corner
This review does not certify registration estimation, simulated draws, or downstream inferential recovery
